TLT.thesis: Long-duration Treasury recession play. Fed forced to cut as growth collapses.
TLT.thesis_invalidation: 30-year yield breaks above 5.10% on sustained basis; stagflation regime confirmed with no recession signal

GLD.thesis: Stagflation hedge; gold performs well when real rates are negative and growth is low.
GLD.thesis_invalidation: Real rates turn strongly positive; growth accelerates with low inflation.

SHY.thesis: Short-term treasury cash proxy; low duration risk.
SHY.thesis_invalidation: Fed aggressively hikes rates beyond expectations.
